name: gpux macOS fast-mode perf and memory
objective: Minimize CPU time and memory for gpux on native macOS in both fast-mode off and on, using benchmark/run.py --target macos. Targets: scroll footprint <=1.3x off (data-table), clock draw p50 <1ms, scroll-div-cards <2ms, fewer allocations per scroll frame, no regressions on retention scenarios.

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.
